text:
maya: paging — alerting about regional health oscillation, multiple regions failing liveness checks in a loop, current pattern us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east, 503/latency spikes, customers seeing higher tails

sam: oncall here, got the page. looking at routing logs now, looks like fallback policy 'fallback_v2' started choosing a tiny quantized model variant in eu (tag="tiny-quant-v1") and that variant has a slow init for certain seq lengths, causing healthcheck success thresholds to miss and then flip back

liam: data: API logs show 503 spikes at 10:07:32, 10:08:01, 10:08:45 repeatedly across all regions. health probe traces show target host in eu responding slowly to the /health with 250-400ms vs expected <100ms

emily: customers impacted: 2 large PLG accounts (acct: fastchat-inc, acct: docwrite) — elevated retries and degraded UX. SLOs hit for both. I'll open a support incident and notify CSMs :exclamation:

incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED — id: INC-2026-43321 — Severity: P2 — Notifying oncall and eng-sre :rotating_light:

sam: quick mitigation idea: force routing to skip eu for fallback_v2 until we fix variant matching. would reduce cross-region oscillation. Any objections?

kj: +1 to skip eu temporarily. also suggests throttling the failure domain by increasing healthcheck grace to 30s to prevent immediate flipflop.

liam: agree. plan: 1) pin fallback_v2 to prefer-region us-east 2) disable tiny-quant-v1 in eu model catalog for serving 3) increase probe grace window 4) monitor for stabilization

maya: executing manual override now — running command: `redwoodctl routing update --policy fallback_v2 --prefer-region us-east --dry-run`

maya: then `redwoodctl routing update --policy fallback_v2 --prefer-region us-east --force` (executed) — returns 200, change rolled

deploy-bot: ROUTING CHANGE APPLIED — policy=fallback_v2, prefer_region=us-east, by=maya, change_id=chg-43321-1

sam: disabling tiny-quant-v1 in eu model catalog: `modelctl disable --region eu --model tiny-quant-v1 --reason "flapping health / slow init"`

kj: increased health probe grace: `infractl probes set --policy fallback_v2 --grace 30s` — applied in all regions

liam: watching metrics... 2m after change, request churn between regions dropped 85%, 503 rate down to baseline. still seeing a few late probes from eu but within threshold

emily: support ticket update sent, CSMs notified, customers on SLAs updated about mitigation and ETA for root cause.

maya: note — root cause looks like model-variant selector matched by quantization tag without checking cold-start latency profiles, so tiny-quant-v1 was eligible for fallback points but had 300ms cold start for longer sequences. I'll file a model-onboarding gap ticket

sam: escalation: open post-incident follow-up, include model onboarding checklist update (add cold-start probe), routing policy stricter variant filters (exclude low-init models from hot fallback), and runbook updates for manual routing overrides

liam: adding commands used to triage (for postmortem):
```
# show recent routing decisions
redwoodctl routing decisions --since 2026-06-01T10:00Z --policy fallback_v2 | jq . | tail -n 50

# inspect health probe traces
infractl logs --service healthprobe --region eu --since 10m | grep tiny-quant-v1
```

maya: timeline summary to include in postmortem: 10:07 root probe deviations begin, 10:09 fallback policy rotates to tiny-quant-v1 in eu, 10:10 oscillation observed, 10:12 manual override applied, 10:14 model variant disabled, 10:16 probes grace increased, 10:20 stability regained

kj: marking incident as mitigated for paging purposes. leaving incident open for RCA and follow-up actions. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — INC-2026-43321 status=mitigated, responders=[maya,sam,liam,kj,emily], timeline_link=https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-43321

emily: action items assigned: [maya] file model onboarding ticket, [liam] update runbook for routing overrides, [sam] validate fix in dedicated staging, [kj] add healthprobe paramization docs. ETA EOD tomorrow

maya: quick note — I'll include a small test harness to measure cold-start for newly onboarded quantized variants to avoid this in future

sam: thanks all, good triage. once RCA draft is up I'll ping legal/comms if we need external customer notice. closing pager for now. :thumbsup:

maya: closing thread summary will be attached to INC-2026-43321 postmortem.
